item.title: Rachel Reeves's car tax set to cost Britain 120,000 vehicles as transport watchdog urgently steps in
item.description: Rachel Reeves’s Autumn Budget has triggered fresh criticism after official forecasts showed a new tax on electric vehicles could lead to 120,000 fewer EVs being sold in Britain. The policy, called Electric Vehicle Excise Duty (eVED), will introduce a new mileage-based charge for electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles from April 2028.
